comment: Chunked-prefill perf baseline (chunk=512). Looser gates than perf_baseline.json (5% decode / 8% prefill) to account for gather + rect-attn overhead per chunk. Re-pinned 2026-10-30 on Qwen3-8B-NVFP4-cortecs when GGUF went legacy (the Qwen3-4B / Qwen3-8B Q8_0 GGUF entries were dropped). Spec-off gate metric (--set speculative.ngram=false), median of 5 trials x 5 reps, 15s cooldown.
_refresh_note: Re-measure with: docker run --rm --gpus all -v $HOME/models:/models imp:test imp-cli --model /models/<model> --bench --bench-pp 512 --bench-reps 5 --max-tokens 256 --temperature 0 --prefill-chunk-size 512 --json --set speculative.ngram=false (5 trials, 15s cooldown, take median)
